reference_note: Upper band Rs 700. At Rs 700: market cap Rs 4,009.75 cr, P/E 78.8x FY26 diluted EPS Rs 8.88, P/B 7.25x, EV/EBITDA 39.1x FY26. Pre-IPO secondary transfers to institutions on 29-30 Sep 2026 were also at Rs 700 (pp. 151-152).
headline: At Rs 700 the price sits in line with listed defence peers on P/E (78.8x vs 73-118x), but revenue fell 22.7% in FY26, operating cash flow was negative in FY25, FY26 and Q1 FY27, and our DCF (Rs 67) is far below the relative value (Rs 832); the offer is entirely a sale by existing holders.
red_flags: Owns its IP outright; largest supplier of thermal imaging systems to Indian government agencies Apr-24 to Mar-26 per the issuer-paid F&S report (pp. 246, 253)
Revenue Rs 428.19 cr -> Rs 469.08 cr -> Rs 362.65 cr FY24-26; exports 65.5% -> 5.6% of revenue; Q1 FY27 loss Rs 17.74 cr (pp. 89, 144)
Cumulative CFO/PAT FY24-26 -63.0%; trade working capital 109.7% of FY26 revenue; working-capital days 152 -> 517 (pp. 87, 90, 144)
Related party CEAQ Singapore: IP bought for Rs 183.19 cr (FY24) and Rs 78.98 cr of FY26 purchases (26.3% of expenses); CEAQ entities sell 91.5 lakh of the 121.7 lakh OFS shares (cover, pp. 94, 439)
Order book Rs 314.24 cr at 30-Jun-2026 plus Rs 118.15 cr of orders in Jul-Sep 2026; cash tax 23.3% of cumulative PBT (pp. 89, 250)
Upper band Rs 700: blended value Rs 373 (Neutral), -46.7%; QIB book 293.6x, total 135.9x at close (NSE) - demand is not a valuation input

28,000+ systems deployed in 24 countries; ITAR-free portfolio (p. 246)
